answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 8392 Country: India Title: My question is, Is it allowed to use mobile while you are in Aiteqaf? Question: Assalamualaikum! My question is, Is it allowed to use mobile while you are in Aiteqaf? Answer ID: 8392 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1308/1122=L/1429) In the state of Itikaf, it is allowed to use mobile phone when needed but only as much as necessary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
